meta.framing: modern relationship psychology without fear-based dosha warnings

core_relationship_lenses.attraction_and_chemistry: Reflects initial spark, shared social energy, and outward relationship style (7th house, Venus, Darapada)[cite: 2].
core_relationship_lenses.inner_bond_and_durability: Reflects deeper emotional alignment, shared values, and long-term staying power (Navamsha D-9 and Upapada Lagna)[cite: 2].

kuta_psychological_translations.varna: Shared life values, maturity orientation, and what each person prioritizes as meaningful.
kuta_psychological_translations.vasya: Mutual influence, responsiveness, and how naturally each partner can reach or sway the other[cite: 10].
kuta_psychological_translations.tara: Day-to-day rhythm ease and how smoothly two people's daily timing flows together.
kuta_psychological_translations.yoni: Physical chemistry, comfort with closeness, and instinctual bodily rapport.
kuta_psychological_translations.graha_maitri: Mental friendship, conversational ease, and shared outlook on life.
kuta_psychological_translations.gana: Core temperament and stress response style—calm/steady vs. brisk/reactive.
kuta_psychological_translations.bhakoot: Emotional tide alignment, shared lifestyle rhythm, and long-term domestic flow.
kuta_psychological_translations.nadi: Nervous-system pacing and constitutional energy balance over sustained closeness.

dosha_and_friction_guardrails.kuja_or_mars_friction: Indicates high drive, directness, or quick heat—channel through clear boundaries and fair conflict rules rather than fear[cite: 2, 3].
dosha_and_friction_guardrails.avoid_superficial_rejection: Never treat a raw compatibility score or single placement as a fixed verdict; look at full chart context, communication habits, and emotional maturity[cite: 2, 10].
